what happened...?

<CHAR 5,0,7,0,0><CV 5,42><NAME 10><TALK 5>For some reason, I've started neighing
like a horse... hihin...

<CV 5,21>This must be that nectar's doing!
Several others seem to have it too.
M-my body itches, brrrrr!
<CHAR 1,0,1,1,0><NAME 1><TALK 1><CV 1,20>Th-that can't be...!

Hihin!

said to appear where it grows, so I'll
support you as much as I can! Hihiiin!
